title: Tensor total complexes commute with restriction after extension of scalars
statement: Let A and B be commutative rings in the same universe, and let $\rho:A\to B$ be a unital ring homomorphism. Let L be any integer-indexed cochain complex of B-modules and K any integer-indexed cochain complex of A-modules. Write Res for termwise restriction of scalars along $\rho$ and Ext for termwise extension of scalars [def-weil-module-base-change]. There exists an isomorphism of A-module cochain complexes $\operatorname{Res}(\operatorname{Tot}(L\otimes_B\operatorname{Ext}(K)))\cong\operatorname{Tot}(\operatorname{Res}(L)\otimes_A K)$, using ordinary module tensors [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and the direct-sum total tensor construction [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. There are no acyclicity, flatness or boundedness hypotheses.

source.place: Tag 06Y1, lemma-base-change-K-flat, proof; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06Y1

proof.text: Use the natural module isomorphisms of [lem-pc-tensor-restrict-extend-module-natural]. For the tensor bicomplex T of L and Ext(K), assemble them in the second complex degree with HomologicalComplex.Hom.isoOfComponents. Its differential compatibility is the naturality equality with f the identity and g the differential of K. Assemble in the first degree with isoOfComponents again. Apply HomologicalComplex.Hom.ext to reduce compatibility to each second-degree component; naturality with f the differential of L and g the identity proves it. This constructs a bicomplex isomorphism f between Res(T) and the tensor bicomplex of Res(L) and K.

Restriction of scalars preserves all coproducts of module objects, by Mathlib ModuleCat.preservesColimit_restrictScalars. The source-library HomologicalComplex₂.mapTotalIso, in WeilConjectures.FromJoel.Algebra.Homology.TotalComplexMap, therefore identifies Tot(Res(T)) with Res(Tot(T)). Compose its inverse with HomologicalComplex₂.total.mapIso f. By the definition of mapBifunctor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], this is precisely the required cochain-complex isomorphism. All coproducts exist even for unbounded integer-indexed complexes.

theorem nonempty_tensorRestrictExtendScalarsIso
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] (ρ : A →+* B)
    (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} B) ℤ)
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) :
    Nonempty
      ((((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (mapBifunctor L
            (((ModuleCat.extendScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K)
            (curriedTensor _))) ≅
        mapBifunctor
          (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars ρ).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj L)
          K (curriedTensor _))
